主要内容: Strauss Group (TASE: STRS), an Israeli-based food and beverage company, is hosting one of the biggest food-tech events of the year, FoodTechIL 2019, which will take place next week in Hanger 11, Tel Aviv Port. The event will host over 1,200 participants from around the world, including senior executives from major Food & Beverage companies such as PepsiCo, Danone, Mondelez, and Jivaudan. Over 50 international startup companies will also exhibit, showcasing the most innovative and breakthrough technologies in food-tech. The event will begin at 8:30 AM and will include a main plenary session and six round table "foodtalks" in partnerships with food and beverage companies, covering topics such as plastics, the future of protein, food & health, circular food, and more. Strauss Group has invested in food tech innovation through the kitchen food tech hub and the formation of Alpha Strauss eight years ago, with a vision to leverage technologies and enable the company to accelerate global growth and provide solutions for major challenges in the food chain value. The startup companies attending the event are working in various fields of the industry, including alternative ingredients, health & wellness, food safety, production systems, and food chain. Ofra Strauss, Chairperson of Strauss Group, emphasized the crucial role of businesses in using technology to make a positive impact on society, people's health, and the environment. Giora BarDea, CEO & President of Strauss Group, highlighted the importance of thinking ahead to stay ahead and preparing for the consumer of the future, noting that Israel is rapidly evolving from the startup nation to the FoodTech nation.
